messages:
maria: heads up — during the late-night fixship multiple PRs landed and CI SAST results are inconsistent across runners. some evidence blobs failed to upload to the keystore, getting 403s. :grimacing:

josh: which PRs? paste links?

maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4231 and /pull/4234 — both touched auth helper and deploy hooks. failures in eu-west runner, us-west passed.

scanner-bot: SAST_SCAN_FAILURE - missing_evidence_id=E-7683 artifact_fetch=403 region=eu-west job=scan-20260321T03Z

anika: saw the log — scan-service ephemeral grant TTL expired while trying to fetch s3 artifact. it retried on a different runner that still had grant, so we have mismatch.

maria: ok, action: preserve current artifacts before we re-issue grants. ops-oncall, can you create a short-lived keystore grant and note it in audit? we need chain-of-custody for compliance. :eyes: 

ops-oncall: creating ephemeral grant for scan-service now (30m). audit note: grant_id=grant-179500-a1, scopes=[s3:ci-artifacts/getObject, kms:Decrypt], reason="triage evidence collection"

anika: command I ran locally to fetch the failed artifact (feel free to reuse):
```
aws s3 cp s3://ci-artifacts/eu-west/4231/sast/evidence/E-7683.json ./evidence/E-7683.json --profile scan-service
```

josh: nice. after we pull, can we bundle logs + artifact and checksum before any PR reverts? compliance needs immutable evidence. propose script: preserve-evidence.sh -> tar + sha256sum + upload to s3://forensics-retention/repo/4231/1795004321

maria: i'll run preserve-evidence.sh now, then create an internal ticket to coordinate rollbacks. also adding an immediate policy: if scan-service gets 403 fetching evidence, don't auto-retry on alternate runner — fail fast and alert oncall. reduces split-state.

ops-oncall: preserved and uploaded: s3://forensics-retention/repo/4231/1795004321/E-7683.tar.gz sha256=3b7f2c9... audit_ref=AR-179500-1

scanner-bot: SAST_EVIDENCE_PRESERVED - evidence_id=E-7683 location=s3://forensics-retention/repo/4231/1795004321/E-7683.tar.gz

anika: next steps: (1) run full scan on a single controlled runner (we'll use us-west), (2) compare hashes to preserved evidence, (3) decide rollback vs patch. I'll own the comparison.

josh: add playbook checklist for this class of failures: ephemeral-grant-expiry -> preserve -> single-runner-rescan -> chain-of-custody note -> decide. keep it tight (5 steps) and add to runbook.

maria: agreed. I'll open runbook PR. tagging @compliance for visibility. anyone object to closing this thread once we have rescan results?

ops-oncall: no objections. rescan scheduled in 12m on us-west. will post results here. :white_check_mark: 

josh: thanks all — good call preventing auto-retries. this pattern would've led to confusing, non-reproducible evidence.

scanner-bot: RESCAN_START job=scan-20260321T03Z-rescan region=us-west

anika: (note for the audit) who accessed preserved tar? ops-oncall+anika+maria — please confirm so compliance can record identities.

maria: confirmed. maria, anika, ops-oncall accessed and checkedums verified.

last: ops-oncall posted rescan result: RESCAN_PASS with same findings and preserved evidence matches sha256. moving to triage flow for remediation.
